visual_action: A montage of video clips from an outdoor event called the 'Unity March'. Various people, many of whom are of Asian descent, are shown marching and holding signs. The U.S. Capitol building is visible in the background of one shot. Some participants are wearing traditional Korean clothing and playing drums. The event has the atmosphere of a protest or rally on a sunny day.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats TikTok account, which implies the party's endorsement of the event and its message.

cast.name: John Lewis
cast.evidence: Multiple signs feature the phrase 'GOOD TROUBLE', a famous quote and philosophy associated with the late Congressman and civil rights leader John Lewis.

on_screen_text.text: "It's an Honor just to be Asian" -Sandra Oh
WE ARE UNITED 혐오를 넘어 화합으로 대동 단결!!
ISANG BAGSAK WE RISE WE FALL TOGETHER

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is entirely set to music.
audio_music: An uplifting, gentle indie-pop track ('Blue Spirits' by DWLLRS) plays continuously throughout the video, creating a hopeful and positive mood for the montage of the march.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage composed of multiple short clips from the event, with moderately paced cuts that align with the background music.
emotions_signaled: Pride (in Asian identity, as shown on signs like 'PROUD to be ASIAN')
Unity/Solidarity (the event is named 'Unity March' and signs read 'WE KEEP US SAFE' and 'WE RISE WE FALL TOGETHER')
Empowerment (signs encouraging people to 'VOTE' and get into 'GOOD TROUBLE')
cultural_references: Sandra Oh, whose quote 'It's an Honor just to be Asian' is featured on a sign.
The phrase 'Isang Bagsak' ('one rise, one fall'), a term and gesture originating from the Filipino-American labor movement, is shown on a sign.
central_claim: The AAPI community and its allies are actively marching for unity, pride, and an end to racism.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of inspiration and solidarity with the AAPI community's activism and to associate the Democratic party with these values.
